best_idea: Store animated tiles as slots that point at static tile sources, swap the pointer on a frame change behind an equality gate, and upload only the changed atlas band, so an animated water or lava tile costs no per-frame pixel work.
decision_why: Keep the grid atlas, half-texel UV inset, pointer-swap slots, equality gate and band rule; drop the 32-variation upload until a phone measurement says it is needed.
acceptance: Client test: applyAnimFrame returns false on a repeated frame, and each change re-points only the animated slots and uploads 8 atlas rows; on a 375-wide phone water tiles change every two game turns with no hitch.
